summary.id: Pilar iman keempat: beriman kepada para utusan Allah.
summary.en: The fourth pillar of faith: believing in Allah's messengers.

text.id: Iman kepada para rasul berarti membenarkan bahwa Allah mengutus mereka untuk menyampaikan petunjuk-Nya. Muslim menghormati seluruh rasul dan mengikuti Nabi Muhammad sebagai rasul terakhir bagi umatnya.
text.en: Faith in the messengers means affirming that Allah sent them to convey His guidance. Muslims honor all messengers and follow Prophet Muhammad as the final messenger for his community.

body.id: Mencintai Rasulullah diwujudkan dengan mempelajari ajarannya dan meneladani akhlaknya berdasarkan sumber yang tepercaya.
body.en: Love for the Messenger is expressed by studying his teachings and emulating his character through reliable sources.

label.id: Saya memahami dasar iman kepada para rasul.
label.en: I understand the foundation of faith in the messengers.
